scene: Warm steam and clinking china welcome you inside the cozy tea room.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a cozy tea room interior along polished wooden floorboards. On the far left sits a counter with a tiered stand of glowing pastries. Granny and her white dog stand left of centre. At centre stands a four-armed brass barista behind polished taps. On the right hangs a cork notice board beside a window.
shown: a silver tiered stand loaded with glowing pastries on the far left counter
a friendly four-armed robot barista polishing a teacup at the centre counter
